name: ZeroBounce
summary: Real-time email validation with status, sub-status, domain and activity signals, plus credit and usage checks.

host.description: API host: the default, the U.S.-only host (api-us) or the EU host (api-eu).

api_key.description: a ZeroBounce API key (API page of your ZeroBounce account)

notes: The API key travels as the api_key query parameter on every call.
A credit is used per validated email, never for an 'unknown' result. Test without credits using the sandbox addresses in the Sandbox Mode docs.
Rate limit on validate: 80,000 requests per 10 seconds (100,000 for ZeroBounce ONE).
Bulk file validation (sendfile, filestatus, getfile, deletefile) lives on a different host, bulkapi.zerobounce.net, and the batch endpoint takes api_key in its JSON body; neither is in this entry.

endpoints.name: Validate one email
endpoints.summary: Status (valid, invalid, catch-all, unknown, spamtrap, abuse, do_not_mail), sub-status, free/MX/domain flags and more for one address.

ip_address.description: IP the email signed up from; can be left out.

timeout.description: Seconds allowed for validation, 3 to 60 (default 30); past it the result is unknown/greylisted.

activity_data.description: Append activity data to the result.

verify_plus.description: Use the Verify+ method, overriding the account setting.

notes: Takes 1 to 30 seconds. Slow or greylisting mail servers come back as unknown, which costs nothing; retry later or use the bulk file API.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: The validation credits left on the account.
notes: A Credits value of -1 means the API key is invalid.

endpoints.name: Get API usage for a date range
endpoints.summary: Counts of API calls and of each status returned between two dates.
